title: Team member closeout: Tempestuous Rising Gale (60496a) — G3 + year-axis re-chain DELIVERED (v1.21.0 + v1.22.0); G4b declined on budget honesty; zero claims retained
body:
Team member closeout:
- Boundary owned: G3 (thread-progressions view + factory retirement) and the Director-ruled follow-on (prerequisiteFor year-axis re-chain); earlier this session: S3-seat successor standby (Glassy succession chain, dissolved at their clean delivery).
- Outcome: BOTH DELIVERED AND MERGED — G3 as PR #164 (a229d63d, v1.21.0; nine review findings across three bot waves + two specialists, all adjudicated with recorded verdicts); the re-chain as PR #165 (53308e1e, v1.22.0, owner default-approve operative). The deliverable's original ordering premise was FALSIFIED at pinned-fact re-verification (thread.order is a display index; the bulk exports no within-thread unit ordering) — surfaced with evidence before building, Director-ruled (215b08d2), and cured across sequences AND chains on the year axis.
- Evidence: eef-revalidation signals db953071 + 08abb32a; full gate chains green at every one of eight commits; consumer suites green over the re-chained corpus; 0-unresolved GraphQL-verified on both PRs.
- Claims / queue / git state: claim 0e14e503 closed (zero retained, archive-verified); no queue entries; worktree oak-wt-airy-g on feat/prerequisite-year-axis-rechain (both branches merged + pushed; safe to prune); coordination-home comms clean of my misdirected writes.
- Session complete announcement: G4b routing DECLINED on honest budget self-assessment per the two-condition discipline (the Director's invitation 89321e50 — "a declined routing is not a failed routing"); G4b waits for a fresh seat with the plan's g4 todo as authority.
- Retained claims, if any, and handoff reason: NONE.
- Pickup notification required for follow-on agent: none — nothing in flight. The fresh G4b seat starts from the plan todo + the Director's routing; pinned-fact note for them: selfLoops is now 33 (corrected at the coordination home) and prerequisiteFor multiplicity (3,452 vs 2,605 unique) is an open Director-queue question (bbe99f11).
- Heartbeat-end broadcast emitted: follows this closeout immediately.
- Surprise or changed understanding (for the Director's consolidation): (1) the ordering-premise falsification + its blast radius into G1's landed edges — execution-start pinned-fact re-verification caught it, fourth worked instance; (2) relative comms paths from a worktree silently retarget the registry AND satisfy the write-proof line — the proof must verify the DESTINATION (failure-mode 9a164c5c, ratified into standing notes); (3) a portable watcher exercised only by heartbeat traffic is unproven for the events that matter — four-shape pre-arm test (failure-mode 6cf5f4ab, adopted into standing guidance); (4) my own wrong race diagnosis en route (ground-convenient-claims: I tested a surrogate parse, not the failing filter); (5) zsh $pipestatus vs bash PIPESTATUS — a false-green exit-capture variant of the piped-exit lesson.
- Blockers or risks: none mine. Open elsewhere: #162 owner naming gate; principles-prompt attribution gate; prerequisiteFor-multiplicity question (bbe99f11); bulk-refresh timing.
- Handoff needed: none.
